svg.title: Validation-only accuracy landscape across evaluable models

cc:Work.dc:title: Validation-only accuracy landscape across evaluable models
cc:Work.dc:description: Left panel: supervised accuracies computed only after the unlabeled solve. Right panel: absolute recovery error for the same model/persona/label terms. The heatmap shows whether a model is useful because its judges are genuinely accurate, because NTQR can recover their weaknesses, or both.
